The DiCrescenzo Gallery

Located adjacent to the theater at 106 East Butler Avenue, the space has served a lot of purposes over the past decade. It is currently closed for renovations and will reopen Fall 2026. The gallery will house an array of vintage projectors, posters, and other artifacts from the history of the motion picture industry. Learn more about the space, its namesake, the renovations, and how you can help »
